sources.title: Mathematics of Public Key Cryptography
sources.scope_read: Pairing/embedding-degree excerpts at chapter 26.3–26.4, especially Theorem26.4.1; isogeny-order excerpt chapter25.4.
sources.supports: Embedding degree and pairing field; conditions for full r-torsion over the embedding extension.
sources.limits: Not a fresh audit of the entire book. Same-field embedding-degree invariance below is an elementary deduction from fixed q and r, not a newly discovered theorem.

sources.title: Algebraic approaches for the Elliptic Curve Discrete Logarithm Problem over prime fields
sources.authors: Christophe Petit, Michiel Kosters, Ange Messeng
sources.scope_read: Abstract, introduction, section2.1 and sections3.1–3.4, including Algorithm1 and partial-cost analysis.
sources.supports: Prior prime-field factor bases from compositions of low-degree maps; auxiliary smooth-subgroup curves need not be isogenous to the target; relation-system cost is unresolved.
sources.limits: Do not infer a practical prime-field speedup. The paper explicitly limits its experiments and analysis.

sources.title: Using Symmetries in the Index Calculus for Elliptic Curves Discrete Logarithm
sources.authors: Jean-Charles Faugere, Pierrick Gaudry, Louise Huot, Guenael Renault
sources.supports: Symmetry-aware solving for point decomposition over nonprime extension fields is established prior work.
sources.limits: PDF retrieval returned403. No full-text-read or independent validation claimed; do not transfer its quoted estimates to prime fields.

sources.title: Notes on summation polynomials
sources.supports: First-fall degree and degree of regularity require separate justification; hardness result is conditional in the elliptic-curve setting.
sources.limits: Worst-case hardness and first-fall observations do not prove that every restricted toy root system or candidate method fails.

sources.title: Small solutions to polynomial equations, and low exponent RSA vulnerabilities
sources.supports: Univariate modular and bivariate integer small-root results have specific settings; extensions to more variables are not automatic.
sources.limits: No general multivariate modular small-root theorem is claimed. The norm certificate in the draft is derived explicitly rather than attributed to an unread theorem.

sources.title: Summation polynomials and the discrete logarithm problem on elliptic curves
sources.supports: Summation-polynomial point-decomposition framing is known prior work.
sources.limits: PDF retrieval returned403. Recover rational points, signs and subgroup membership before treating a polynomial zero as a valid relation.
